identity.name: E1
identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.

theme.strategy: High Contrast Swiss with Organic Accents

visual_enhancers.gradients: None. Use solid blocks of color.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-10 px-6 rounded-md font-medium transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-10 px-6 rounded-md font-medium
buttons.outline: border-2 border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-primary-foreground h-10 px-6 rounded-md font-medium

cards.default: bg-card text-card-foreground border border-border rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm
cards.interactive: bg-card text-card-foreground border border-border rounded-xl p-6 shadow-sm hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer

inputs.default: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

badges.default: inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2 border-transparent bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/80
badges.secondary: inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2 border-transparent bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80

layouts.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 auto-rows-[180px]

login.layout: Split screen. Left: 50% width image (login_hero) with dark overlay and branding. Right: 50% width clean form.

dashboard.layout: Sidebar navigation (left). Top header (search, profile). Main content area with Bento Grid.

chat.layout: Three pane. 1. Conversation List (Search, Filter, List Items). 2. Chat Window (Header, Messages, Input). 3. Context Panel (Customer Info, Order History, AI Suggestions).

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or subtle noise textures.
Use 'Manrope' for all headings and 'Inter' for body text.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states.
All charts must use the defined 'chart_colors'.
Never use generic 'Lorem Ipsum'. Use realistic fashion retail data.
The 'AI' features should be highlighted with the 'accent' color (Lime #D4FF33) to stand out against the 'primary' (Emerald #044736).
